title: University of British Columbia International Scholars Program
description: UBC International Scholars Program awards are offered to outstanding international students entering undergraduate studies at the University of British Columbia. There are four categories: Karen McKellin International Leader of Tomorrow Award, Donald A. Wehrung International Student Award, International Impact Award, and Vantage One Excellence Award.
amount: Full tuition, fees, and living costs; proportional to demonstrated financial need; valued up to CAD 80,000 per year
eligibility: International students entering UBC from a recognized secondary school or transferring from another post-secondary institution; demonstrate superior academic achievement and financial need; nominated by school or self-nominated

title: McGill University Entrance Scholarship for International Students
field: Arts, Science, Engineering, Management, Education, Music, Agriculture
description: McGill University offers merit-based entrance scholarships to international students entering undergraduate programs. The scholarships recognize outstanding academic achievement and leadership potential.
amount: One-year award valued at CAD 3,000 to CAD 12,000; renewable based on academic performance
eligibility: International students entering first-year undergraduate programs; minimum academic average of 95% or equivalent; demonstrated leadership in school or community activities

title: University of Waterloo International Student Scholarship
field: Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Science, Environment, Arts
description: The University of Waterloo offers several scholarship programs for international students including the International Master's Award of Excellence and the President's Graduate Scholarship. These awards support top-tier students in research-intensive programs.
amount: International Master's Award of Excellence: CAD 2,500 per term for up to 5 terms; President's Graduate Scholarship: up to CAD 10,000 per year
eligibility: International students with outstanding academic records; enrolled full-time in a graduate program; research-based programs preferred

title: University of Alberta International Student Scholarship
field: Engineering, Science, Business, Agriculture, Arts, Medicine, Education
description: The University of Alberta provides a range of scholarships for international students, including the International Entrance Leadership Scholarship and the Graduate Assistantship program. These awards recognize academic excellence and leadership.
amount: International Entrance Leadership Scholarship: up to CAD 5,000; Graduate Assistantship: up to CAD 28,000 per year plus tuition remission
eligibility: International students with high academic standing; leadership and community involvement; meeting English language requirements

title: University of Calgary International Entrance Scholarship
field: Engineering, Business, Science, Arts, Kinesiology, Nursing, Architecture
description: The University of Calgary International Entrance Scholarship is awarded to outstanding international students beginning their undergraduate studies. The scholarship recognizes academic achievements and contributions to the community.
amount: CAD 15,000 renewable annually for up to 4 years; total value up to CAD 60,000
eligibility: International students entering first year of an undergraduate degree program; minimum admission average of 85%; strong extracurricular profile

title: York University International Student Scholarship
field: Arts, Science, Engineering, Business, Law, Health, Environmental Studies
description: York University offers the Global Leader of Tomorrow Award and the International Entrance Scholarship for international students who demonstrate academic excellence and leadership qualities.
amount: Global Leader of Tomorrow Award: CAD 20,000 per year; International Entrance Scholarship: CAD 5,000 to CAD 15,000 one-time
eligibility: International students entering first-year undergraduate studies; academic average of 90% or higher; demonstrated leadership experience

title: American University Emerging Global Leader Scholarship
field: International Relations, Business, Communications, Political Science, Economics, Environmental Studies
description: The AU Emerging Global Leader Scholarship promotes educational access and opportunity while enhancing international diversity. It is awarded to one exceptional international student who demonstrates leadership potential and commitment to positive civic and social change.
amount: Full tuition, room, board, and fees for four years of undergraduate study
eligibility: International students from any country; outstanding academic record; demonstrated leadership and commitment to service; must be applying for first-year admission

title: University of Michigan International Undergraduate Scholarship
field: Engineering, Business, Science, Arts, Architecture, Music, Nursing
description: The University of Michigan offers the International Undergraduate Scholarship to exceptional students from around the world. The scholarship is competitive and awarded based on academic merit, extracurricular involvement, and personal essays.
amount: Up to USD 25,000 per year; total potential value up to USD 100,000 over 4 years
eligibility: International students applying for first-year admission; exceptional academic credentials; strong SAT/ACT scores or equivalent; demonstrated extracurricular excellence

title: Purdue University International Student Scholarship
field: Engineering, Science, Technology, Agriculture, Management, Pharmacy, Veterinary Medicine
description: Purdue University provides various merit-based scholarships for international students, including the Purdue Presidential Scholarship and the Ross Fellowship for graduate students. These support academic and research excellence.
amount: Presidential Scholarship: up to USD 16,000 per year; Ross Fellowship: full tuition waiver plus stipend of USD 25,000-30,000 per year
eligibility: International students with excellent academic records; SAT/ACT for undergraduates; GRE for graduates; strong research background for graduate fellowships

title: Illinois Wesleyan University International Student Scholarship
field: Liberal Arts, Business, Fine Arts, Nursing, Sciences, Music, Theatre
description: Illinois Wesleyan University offers merit-based scholarships and need-based financial aid to qualified international students. The President's Scholarship and the International Student Scholarship are the most prestigious awards.
amount: President's Scholarship: full tuition worth up to USD 50,000 per year; International Student Scholarship: USD 16,000-30,000 per year
eligibility: International first-year applicants; outstanding academic record; strong extracurricular activities; SAT/ACT scores recommended but not required

title: Clark University Global Scholars Program
field: Arts, Sciences, Business, Environmental Science, Psychology, International Development
description: The Global Scholars Program at Clark University is open to first-year international applicants who have demonstrated outstanding academic performance and a commitment to global engagement and social change.
amount: USD 15,000 to USD 25,000 per year for four years; additional USD 5,000 taxable stipend for internship or research
eligibility: First-year international applicants; strong academic record; demonstrated interest in global issues and community engagement; not a US citizen or permanent resident

title: CONACYT Mexico Government Scholarship for International Students
field: Engineering, Biotechnology, Environmental Science, Health Sciences, Social Sciences, Humanities, Agriculture
description: The National Council for Science and Technology (CONACYT) offers scholarships to international students to pursue postgraduate studies and research in Mexico at participating institutions. The program promotes scientific cooperation and academic exchange.
amount: Monthly stipend MXN 12,000-18,000, full tuition fee waiver, medical insurance through IMSS, relocation support
university: Various Mexican Universities and Research Centers
eligibility: International students with bachelor's or master's degree; research proposal aligned with Mexican priority areas; Spanish proficiency recommended
source: National Council for Science and Technology (CONACYT)

title: Tec de Monterrey International Scholarship
field: Engineering, Business, Information Technology, Architecture, Health Sciences, Social Sciences, Design
description: Tecnológico de Monterrey offers the International Student Scholarship and the Líderes del Mañana Scholarship for outstanding international students. These support academic excellence and leadership development at one of Latin America's top universities.
amount: Líderes del Mañana: 100% tuition coverage plus living stipend; International Student Scholarship: 30%-70% tuition reduction
eligibility: International students with exceptional academic records; leadership experience; community involvement; financial need for full scholarship

title: CAPES Brazil International Scholarship Program
field: Engineering, Biological Sciences, Health Sciences, Agriculture, Social Sciences, Humanities, Exact Sciences
description: CAPES (Coordination for the Improvement of Higher Education Personnel) provides scholarships for international students to pursue graduate studies and research at Brazilian universities. The program strengthens Brazil's position as a research destination.
amount: Monthly stipend BRL 2,100 for Master, BRL 3,000 for PhD, BRL 4,100 for Postdoctoral; tuition waiver; research support grant
eligibility: International students from developing countries; academic excellence; research proposal aligned with Brazilian research priorities; proficiency in Portuguese or Spanish preferred
source: CAPES (Coordination for the Improvement of Higher Education Personnel)

title: University of São Paulo International Scholarship
field: Engineering, Medicine, Science, Humanities, Law, Economics, Architecture
description: The University of São Paulo (USP) offers the USP International Scholarship for graduate students. It provides financial support for international students pursuing master's and doctoral degrees at Brazil's top-ranked university.
amount: Monthly stipend BRL 2,100 for Master, BRL 3,100 for PhD; tuition fee waiver; research support funding; conference travel allowance
eligibility: International graduate applicants with excellent academic records; research proposal; Portuguese proficiency recommended; some programs offered in English

title: CONICET Argentina Doctoral Fellowship for International Students
field: Biology, Physics, Chemistry, Engineering, Earth Sciences, Social Sciences, Humanities, Agricultural Sciences
description: The National Scientific and Technical Research Council (CONICET) offers doctoral fellowships to international students to conduct research in Argentina. The program supports Argentina's scientific and technological development through international cooperation.
amount: Monthly stipend ARS 180,000-220,000, research funding, social security benefits, health coverage, annual bonus
university: CONICET Research Institutes and Partner Universities
eligibility: International students with a master's degree or equivalent; research proposal aligned with CONICET priority areas; Spanish proficiency required
source: National Scientific and Technical Research Council (CONICET)

title: University of Buenos Aires International Graduate Scholarship
field: Engineering, Medicine, Law, Economics, Social Sciences, Architecture, Arts, Natural Sciences
description: The University of Buenos Aires (UBA) provides scholarships for international graduate students through its International Relations Office. The program promotes academic exchange and supports students from around the world.
amount: Monthly living stipend, tuition fee waiver, health insurance, access to university facilities, Spanish language courses
eligibility: International students with undergraduate or graduate degrees; strong academic records; Spanish proficiency B1 or higher; commitment to academic excellence

title: Becas Chile International Scholarship (ANID)
field: Engineering, Natural Sciences, Health Sciences, Education, Social Sciences, Arts, Technology
description: The National Agency for Research and Development (ANID) of Chile offers Becas Chile for international students to pursue postgraduate studies and research in Chile. The program promotes Chile as a destination for scientific and academic excellence.
amount: Monthly stipend CLP 800,000-1,200,000, full tuition waiver, health insurance, relocation allowance, annual book allowance
eligibility: International students from Latin American and Caribbean countries preferred; bachelor's or master's degree; research alignment with Chilean development priorities
source: National Agency for Research and Development (ANID)

title: ICETEX Colombia International Scholarship
field: Engineering, Environmental Science, Peace Studies, Agriculture, Health Sciences, Education, Social Sciences
description: ICETEX (Colombian Institute of Educational Credit and Technical Studies Abroad) offers scholarships to international students to study in Colombia. The program supports Colombia's internationalization of higher education and cultural exchange.
amount: Monthly stipend COP 2,500,000-3,500,000, full tuition waiver, health insurance, Spanish language course, cultural activities
eligibility: International students from eligible countries; academic excellence; Spanish proficiency A2 minimum; commitment to promoting Colombian culture upon return
source: Colombian Institute of Educational Credit and Technical Studies Abroad (ICETEX)
